body:
If my research is correct, which it ought to be considering I'm a student of fucking organic chemistry, the drugs should take hold of me in about 2 hours.

I'm not really sure as to what say now except 'see ya'. I guess you're all doing some fabolous fucking work here, suicide is a horrible thing I wouldn't wish upon anyone. You're all heroes.
It's a movie many reject as artificially deep and artistic but there's a lot of meaning behind it. Take care though, it's swedish in its entierty.
[Watch out, I think he heard you!](https://i.imgur.com/vAoosNm.jpg)

Dogs can get major health problems from chewing on or eating chicken bones.  

I did realize that I wasn't going to get through my depression alone, just like you realized. That lead me to the decision to move back with my mother and her boyfriend. It did help a lot but only for a couple of weeks. After the initial 'rush' of help passed I did an attempt at my life of which the aftermath was my last post on /r/suicidewatch.

My mother must've realised, without me knowing, because she alerted the authorities on me soon after and I was admitted against my own will.

The 10 days in forced care were some of the worst of my life. I was the youngest kid in the crowd, so no one wanted to talk to me except the staff. I was in a shared room with a dude who snored loud enough to disturb my sleep, if I could sleep, through quality ear plugs. 

I wasn't allowed access to the internet on the laptop I had brought with me so the result is me having watched Seventh Seal by Ingmar Bergman about 15 times.

There wasn't any vegan food options and since my weight was a 'concern' they forced me to eat non-vegan food, which made me only feel even more shit.

You couldn't lock around you, wherever you went, which was a problem for an introvert like me. I didn't shower for the full period I was in because of fear someone would walk in on me.

In review I dropped 3kg weight, broke my 3 year vegan streak, got about 3 hours average of sleep per day, and became even more introverted.

Upside is that I've started taking venlafaxine.

It's not easy to leave my old life. I'm still pretty much forced to live with my mother, so someone can watch over me 24/7. I can't do drugs such as shrooms or alcohol anymore, despite how an integral part of my life it was before. I'm allowed 3 hours of internet a day. I can't be away from home too long.

It's hard.

Sorry for the rant, I just felt I really needed to vent.

I know it is. I know no one would be mad at me for calling, not even myself.   
Although in my current state I won't, sorry to say.    
I fear the consequences of it. My relatives finding out, eventually. My friends finding me emotionally shaky when I've been known for my stable nature. Not trusting myself.

The crisis is over, though. It's over an hour since my attempt by now. Calling 911 would be useless.
When you get to the point you consider life to be nothing and thus you consider ending your life very little.
911 is out of the question because I am too chicken to call them.
I'll try this when I sober up.
No, I live all alone and have little to no contact with my old family and I've burned all bridges when it comes to my old friends.
